## GET `/publicMatches`

Get list of randomly sampled public matches

Operation ID: `get_public_matches`.

### SDK call

```ts
const { data, meta } = await client.get("/publicMatches", {});
```

### Parameters

Path parameters: none.

#### Query parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `less_than_match_id` | `DecimalId` | No | Not specified | Get matches with a match ID lower than this value Decimal string identifier. |
| `min_rank` | `number` | No | Not specified | Minimum rank for the matches. Ranks are represented by integers (10-15: Herald, 20-25: Guardian, 30-35: Crusader, 40-45: Archon, 50-55: Legend, 60-65: Ancient, 70-75: Divine, 80: Immortal). Each increment represents an additional star. Integer. |

```ts

```
